decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for Council Repair Service Storage purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times08.00-19.00 Monday-Saturday, 10.00 - 16.00 Sunday & Public Holidays
Condition : 4 - No flammable chemicals (identified within the HAZCHEM database) shall be stored on site at any time without the further consent of the Local Plannin Authority.
Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The premises shall be used for car parking spaces, B8 storage areas and offices associated with Local Authority business and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class       of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 7 - Before any plant and/or machinery is used on the premises, it shall be enclosed with sound-insulating material and mounted in a way which will minimise transmission of structure borne sound in accordance with a scheme to be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Works to basement carpark incorporating the creation of 22 car parking spaces, storage areas, and offices
